Question: For every integer \(n\ge2,\) let \(\operatorname{pow}(n)\) be the largest power of the largest prime that divides \(n.\) For example, \(\operatorname{pow}(144)=\operatorname{pow}(2^4\cdot3^2)=3^2.\) What is the largest integer \(m\) such that \(2010^m\) divides \[\prod_{n=2}^{5300}\operatorname{pow}(n)?\]
